description: High-risk change ledger for the Risk Gate check. A pull request that touches any listed path, or carries any listed label, passes only with an approving review by the repository owner on the exact current head commit.

labels.name: high-risk
labels.reason: Renovate and humans mark dependency updates that reach parsers, money handling, or authentication with this label.

rules.reason: CORE schema DDL is append-only and is applied to production by CD.
Authentication and authorization code decides who may read evidence; the ingest-client declaration and its rendered bootstrap SQL decide which producer may register under which source.
Collector code and its dependency closure run with the bank credentials of its source; whoever can deploy or change what it bundles can also read and send them.
Workflows and their trusted scripts hold the merge, deploy, and gate decisions themselves.
Worker configuration and the resource ledgers decide which production resources a deploy writes to.
